data.name: Fir
data.gender_notes: Fir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘ifra’, meaning ‘a man’ or ‘a free man’. In Islamic history, Fir was the name of a powerful figure in the story of Prophet Sulaiman (Solomon) who ruled over the jinn. This name is a reminder of the freedom and power granted to us by Allah. The name Fir carries the meaning “Man, free” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fir usually hope their child will grow to embody man, free and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of Allah's power and blessings.
data.etymology: Fir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Man, free.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fir total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_english.name: Fir
in_english.meaning: Derived from Arabic root, means elevation, height, and superiority
in_english.long_meaning: The name 'Fir' originates from the Arabic root 'F-R-R', which signifies elevation, height, and superiority. This name is occasionally used to denote high status and prestige. In Islamic tradition, 'Fir' carries beautiful and commendable connotations, symbolizing lofty stature and spiritual ascension. Historically, names with similar roots have been used to express nobility and exalted positions.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fir is a connection to the rich history and cultural heritage of the Islamic world, specifically the story of Prophet Sulaiman and his rule over the jinn. This name brings a sense of pride and identity to those who bear it, as it represents a link to the past and the legacy of great leaders and allegorical figures in Islamic lore.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Fir holds a deeper spiritual significance as it serves as a reminder of the freedom and power that Allah has bestowed upon us. In the same way that Fir was a powerful ruler over the jinn, we too have the power to make choices that shape our lives and the world around us. This name encourages us to use our power wisely and in accordance with the will of Allah. It also serves as a reminder to value our own worth as human beings and to strive for the freedom and dignity that comes from living in accordance with Islamic values.
